overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that content centered around 'self respect' and boundary-setting (e.g., deleting chats, removing names, turning off read receipts) consistently outperforms general emotional topics like 'अधूरी मोहब्बत' or vague 'रात के ख्याल'. Videos dealing with tactical digital actions yield higher view counts (30-41 views) compared to abstract late-night musings (under 20 views). Confidence is moderate due to a small overall view sample size.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'rwOUYo_hayQ' (41 views) and 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (41 views) use specific digital UI triggers like status lists and chat deletion.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on tangible smartphone interaction moments related to letting go.

winning_patterns.evidence: Topics tagged under 'self respect' outperform passive 'overथिंकिंग' and 'रात के ख्याल' videos.
winning_patterns.action: Frame the narrative around choosing oneself rather than lingering in sadness.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'uIbMpCjVutQ' ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') received only 6 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly poetic or cliché metaphors that lack a concrete, real-life anchor.
